Network Security

Rilevamento del percorso laterale

The process of identifying unauthorized lateral movement within a network, typically by monitoring for abnormal access or connection patterns between hosts. Referenced in MITRE ATT&CK (T1075), NIST SP 800-61, and CIS Controls.

Quick answer: The process of identifying unauthorized lateral movement within a network, typically by monitoring for abnormal access or connection patterns between hosts. Referenced in MITRE ATT&CK (T1075), NIST SP 800-61, and CIS Controls.
